valuation.method: Forward Adjusted Diluted EPS x P/E (FY2027 adjusted diluted EPS viewed at the 12-month target date)

bear.driver: Specialty pharmaceutical volume growth moderates and MWI Animal Health / Covetrus integration headwinds weigh on margins
bear.assumption: FY2027 adjusted diluted EPS $19.00 at 17.0x P/E

base.driver: FY2027 adjusted diluted EPS lands near the midpoint of management's $19.40-$19.75 guidance (+8% to +10% YoY) on steady specialty distribution demand
base.assumption: FY2027 adjusted diluted EPS $19.60 at 19.5x P/E

bull.driver: Stronger biosimilar and oncology specialty mix plus faster-than-guided MWI/Covetrus accretion drive upside to FY2027 EPS
bull.assumption: FY2027 adjusted diluted EPS $20.25 at 21.5x P/E

valuation.implied_by_close: At base FY2027 adjusted diluted EPS of $19.60, the $359.03 close implies 18.3x forward P/E.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $19.60 (5.5 pp of price return).
valuation.watch_metric: Specialty pharmaceutical volume growth, operating margin expansion, and FY2027 adjusted diluted EPS guidance execution ($19.40-$19.75)

analyst_notes: Following Cencora's Q4 FY2026 earnings release on November 4, 2026, Baird (Eric Coldwell) and Leerink Partners (Michael Cherny) both raised their price targets to $405 while maintaining Outperform ratings. All six tracked analysts maintain Buy-equivalent ratings, with targets ranging from $377 to $405 as of the November 13, 2026 cutoff (note: Wells Fargo's subsequent raise to $400 on November 17, 2026 falls after the cutoff). Street targets cluster slightly above our $382.20 base case, reflecting higher assumed forward P/E multiples (roughly 20.0x-20.7x on $19.60 base EPS).
